description: A PostHog survey: questions shown to users in-app (popover or widget), on a hosted page, or collected through the API.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the survey belongs to.

Name.description: Survey name. In-app surveys send it to visitors' browsers and hosted surveys show it publicly, so keep private details out of it.

Description.description: Internal survey description. Never delivered to visitors.

Schedule.description: `once` shows the survey once per user (PostHog's default), `recurring` repeats every IterationFrequencyDays, `always` shows it every time the conditions match.

LinkedFlagId.description: ID of a feature flag linked to the survey: the survey is shown only to users with the flag enabled.

LinkedInsightId.description: ID of an insight linked to the survey.

TargetingFlagFilters.description: Person targeting as a JSON feature-flag filters object (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"groups": [{"properties": [{"key": "email", "value": ["@example.com"], "operator": "icontains", "type": "person"}], "rollout_percentage": 100}]}. PostHog keeps it on a targeting flag it manages. Removing the property removes the targeting.

TargetingFlagId.description: ID of the targeting flag PostHog manages for TargetingFlagFilters.

Questions.description: Questions as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString). Each question has a `type` (`open`, `link`, `rating`, `single_choice` or `multiple_choice`), `question`, and type-specific fields such as `choices`, `scale`, `display`, `link` and `branching`. PostHog assigns an `id` to questions without one.

Conditions.description: Display conditions as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString): `url`, `urlMatchType`, `selector`, `deviceTypes`, `seenSurveyWaitPeriodInDays`, `events`, `actions` and so on.

Appearance.description: Appearance customization as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString): colours, `position`, `submitButtonText`, `thankYouMessageHeader`, `whiteLabel` and so on.

Translations.description: Survey-level translations as a JSON object keyed by language code (use Fn::ToJsonString). Question translations go inside each question.

StartDate.description: ISO 8601 launch time. Setting it launches the survey.

EndDate.description: ISO 8601 end time. Setting it completes the survey.

ResponsesLimit.description: Number of responses after which the survey stops automatically.

IterationCount.description: For a recurring schedule, how many times the survey is shown to a user.

IterationFrequencyDays.description: For a recurring schedule, the number of days between survey iterations.

RepeatUntilStopped.description: For a recurring schedule, keep repeating until the survey is stopped (IterationCount is then ignored).

EnablePartialResponses.description: Store a response as soon as one question is answered (true) instead of when all are answered (false).

EnableIframeEmbedding.description: Allow the hosted survey page to be embedded in an iframe.

BaseLanguage.description: BCP-47 code of the language of the survey's untranslated text. PostHog defaults to `en`.

ResponseSamplingIntervalType.description: Unit of the response sampling interval.

ResponseSamplingInterval.description: Length of the response sampling interval, in ResponseSamplingIntervalType units.

ResponseSamplingLimit.description: Maximum number of responses collected per sampling interval.
